steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The relationship between performer and audience is central to the experience of dance | Key Fact: Different venues — studios, theatres, outdoor spaces — affect how a performance is presented and received | Key Fact: A proscenium arch theatre creates a clear separation between performer and audience, framing the dance like a picture | Key Fact: Thrust and in-the-round stages bring the audience closer, creating intimacy and changing the performer's focus

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from performance &amp; the audience, and one past-paper question.
